# Garuda Lawn Care

> Grass cutting, lawn mowing and lawn maintenance for homes in Brampton, Mississauga, Oakville and Milton, Ontario. Owner-operated, based in Brampton. Grass cutting starts from $50 per visit, priced by lot size, with no contracts.

Garuda Lawn Care is a residential lawn care company serving the west Greater Toronto Area. Core service: weekly and bi-weekly grass cutting with edge trimming. Also offers fertilization, weed control, overseeding, spring and fall cleanup, and sod installation. Rated 5.0 on Google. Open 7 AM to 9 PM, seven days a week. Phone and text: (437) 876-5492.

## Service areas
- [Brampton](https://garudalawncare.ca/lawn-care-brampton.html)
- [Mississauga](https://garudalawncare.ca/lawn-care-mississauga.html)
- [Oakville](https://garudalawncare.ca/lawn-care-oakville.html) (north of the QEW/403)
- [Milton](https://garudalawncare.ca/lawn-care-milton.html)

## Services
- [Grass Cutting & Mowing](https://garudalawncare.ca/grass-cutting-mowing.html) — from $50 per visit
- [Sod Installation](https://garudalawncare.ca/sod-installation.html) — $4 per sq ft, $990 minimum

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are per visit for bi-weekly service; weekly service is $5 less per visit.
- No contracts. Quotes are free; Garuda usually replies the same day.
